_comment: Hand-crafted, realistically-shaped example of a Luma discovery API response (GET https://api.luma.com/discover/get-paginated-events?slug=tech&...). Built by reading the LumaEvent/LumaEventEntry/LumaApiResponse interfaces in lib/parsers/luma-parser.ts rather than copied from a live response, to avoid ever including real organizer/attendee data. All event names, URLs, and descriptions below are synthetic placeholders and do not reference any real Luma event.

event.name: Berlin AI Builders Hackathon
event.description: A weekend hackathon for developers building with artificial intelligence and machine learning. Open to teams working on AI agents, computer vision, or NLP prototypes.

event.name: Amsterdam Web3 Buildathon
event.description: A buildathon for blockchain and web3 developers building decentralized apps and smart contracts.

event.name: Hackathon Winners Celebration Party
event.description: Join us to celebrate the winners of last month's hackathon with food and drinks.
